university.name: Loughborough University
university.summary: Loughborough University has its main campus in the market town of Loughborough, Leicestershire, in the East Midlands.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, or 4 years full-time with placement year
courses.overview: Full-time honours degree in computer science, available over three years or with a placement year. The course page lists compulsory modules in programming, systems, artificial intelligence and team projects, plus optional modules.
courses.academic_requirements: Typical UK offer: AAA including Maths. IB 37 (6,6,6 HL) including HL Maths. BTEC Extended Diploma D*D*D plus A Level Maths at grade A. GCSE grades 9 to 6 in five subjects including Maths, and English Language grade 4/C. A reduced contextual offer may apply to UK applicants.
courses.english_requirements: University standard undergraduate level (Computer Science is not on the list of courses needing a higher level): IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with not less than 6.0 in each test; PTE 65 overall with not less than 61 in each sub-test; Duolingo overall 120 (sub-test minimums on the page not fully captured).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Students taking the Intermediate/Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC) need to complete a suitable Foundation Year first (the university offers one through ONCAMPUS). Students with A Level or IB qualifications are considered for direct entry.
courses.notes: Course page shows only October 2026 entry and the 2026/27 international fee of 30,700 per year; target year fee not yet published and no 2027 intake visible, so intake_labels left empty. Module page does not assign modules to years. TOEFL left null because the English page changed TOEFL scoring for tests taken from 21 January 2026. Placement year international fee is about 20 per cent of the full-time fee.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: One-year full-time master's open to graduates in any subject. Semester modules cover programming, databases, algorithms, software engineering, web development and artificial intelligence, followed by a summer project.
highlights: Computing Individual Project or Computing Collaborative Project (choose one)
courses.english_requirements: University standard for postgraduate taught courses: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with not less than 6.0 in each element; PTE 67 overall with not less than 63 in each sub-test; TOEFL iBT 88 with not less than 21 in each test (as published on the page, which does not mention the January 2026 TOEFL change); Duolingo 120 overall with not less than 105 in each sub-test.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Four-year degree only: lower second equivalent is grade C+ or GPA 2.6, upper second is B or GPA 3.0, first is A- or GPA 3.7. Two or three year Bachelor plus Masters: lower second is 50% plus GPA 2.6. Values are published as GPA, not CGPA.
courses.notes: Course page shows September 2026 start and the 2026/27 international fee; target year fee not yet published and no 2027 intake visible, so intake_labels left empty. Pakistan GPA figure of 2.6 is the published lower second equivalent for a four-year degree and is entered as pk_min_cgpa on the page's GPA basis.

courses.title: Finance and Management
courses.overview: One-year full-time master's for graduates of non-finance subjects, combining management and corporate finance modules with a consultancy project. The page lists compulsory and optional modules.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 (55%) headline requirement; a good honours degree in a non-finance field, with evidence of numerical proficiency.
courses.english_requirements: University standard for postgraduate taught courses: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with not less than 6.0 in each element; PTE 67 overall with not less than 63 in each sub-test; TOEFL iBT 88 with not less than 21 in each test (as published on the page, which does not mention the January 2026 TOEFL change); Duolingo 120 overall with not less than 105 in each sub-test. The course page does not state a score itself.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Four-year degree only: lower second equivalent is grade C+ or GPA 2.6, upper second is B or GPA 3.0, first is A- or GPA 3.7. Values are published as GPA, not CGPA.
courses.notes: Course page shows October 2025 and October 2026 starts, the 2025/26 and 2026/27 international fees, and modules marked indicative for 2025/26. Target year fee not yet published and no 2027 intake visible, so intake_labels left empty. Page does not state the English score, so the university-wide postgraduate taught standard is used.

scholarships.name: Excellence Scholarship (postgraduate taught)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,000 off tuition fees for international students starting in September 2026 (GBP 3,000 for UK students)
scholarships.summary: Tuition reduction for self-funded taught master's students with a first class degree or international equivalent, considered automatically from the application and final degree result. Excludes creative arts, design, sport, exercise and health sciences departments and MBA programmes.
scholarships.criteria_text: Self-funding student with a first class degree or international equivalent, not in receipt of another university award other than the Alumni Bursary. Programmes starting in September or January on the Loughborough and London campuses; some departments and MBA excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page. No separate application is required.
scholarships.notes: Page gives terms for January 2026 (20 per cent off tuition) and September 2026 starts only; 2027 terms not yet published. Whether an offer is needed before consideration is not stated.

scholarships.name: Future Leaders Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 10,000 tuition fee discount applied to the first year of study
scholarships.summary: Tuition discount for self-funded international fee-paying students who hold an undergraduate or postgraduate taught offer and show leadership skills, future plans and commitment to study at Loughborough. Some awards are reserved for students from named countries; a global option is open to any international applicant.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee-paying, self-funded with funds shown for remaining tuition and living costs, and holding an undergraduate or postgraduate taught offer before applying. Only one scholarship can be held; the highest value is awarded.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026 round: applications to study by 15 April and scholarship application by 6 May 2026; announcements by 1 June 2026. 2027 round dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Page does not state the entry year; the dates shown are for the 2026 round. Pakistan is not among the countries named for reserved awards; the page states it is open to all international students.
